title: On import notification failed
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

When an episode of a TV show can not be handled by the automatic import, I want to use the "On import" Notification, but failed with the following desbug message : 

2025-04-09 05:57:26.8|Error|NotificationService|Unable to send OnManualInteractionRequired notification to On interaction

[v4.0.14.2939] System.ArgumentNullException: Value cannot be null. (Parameter 'values')
   at System.String.Join(String separator, IEnumerable`1 values)
   at NzbDrone.Core.Notifications.CustomScript.CustomScript.OnManualInteractionRequired(ManualInteractionRequiredMessage message) in ./Sonarr.Core/Notifications/CustomScript/CustomScript.cs:line 421
   at NzbDrone.Core.Notifications.NotificationService.Handle(ManualInteractionRequiredEvent message) in ./Sonarr.Core/Notifications/NotificationService.cs:line 381

It seems that somewhere in the code the value "Null" is  set (returned by the GetTagLabels method) but can't be used in a "join". Probably because the variable series is also set to "Null"

-> environmentVariables.Add("Sonarr_Series_Tags", string.Join("|", GetTagLabels(series))); 

 -> private List<string> GetTagLabels(Series series)
        {
            if (series == null)
            {
                return null;
            }
.....

### Expected Behavior

The custom Script should have all its mandatory variables correctly set.

### Steps To Reproduce

_No response_

### Environment

```markdown
- OS: RPI OS
- Sonarr: 4.0.14.2939
- Docker Install: Yes
- Using Reverse Proxy: No
- Browser: Firefox 137
- Database: Sqlite 3.48.0
```

### What branch are you running?

Main

   at NzbDrone.Core.Notifications.NotificationService.Handle(ManualInteractionRequiredEvent message) in ./Sonarr.Core/Notifications/NotificationService.cs:line 381
